title: Tenma Tsukasa — Unwavering Resolve〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Wonderland SEKAI
Harbor

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We were supposed to meet here for today's practice, but...
se_walk_men_001_1

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Oh, there you all are.
Why are you gathered around the tree?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Ah, Tsukasa...
We were just making sure that it's doing okay.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, we wanted to make sure there weren't any black fragments like before.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I see.
As far as I can tell, everything seems normal.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. But what if it happens again...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hmm... They did appear totally out of the blue.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
This SEKAI may yet hold many more secrets.
I was honestly startled by how those fragments made you all fall asleep.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: To be fair, someone being awake one moment and asleep the next was hardly a first for this SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, really?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
We have you to thank, Luka.
Still, I'm glad that you all woke up and there weren't any problems!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Me too. I didn't know what we were gonna do if you guys stayed asleep...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I see. That means we caused you all quite a lot of concern.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It was my fault for not thinking twice before touching them. I ended up dragging us all into that dream...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I mean, we don't blame you.
None of us thought we'd end up in that state.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! If you didn't touch them, Rui, then I probably would've!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hey, don't act so proud!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: In any case, I don't think it was an entirely bad experience since we gained a new level of understanding of this SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, I agree...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: However, now that we know what those fragments do, we may want to refrain from touching anything we don't recognize.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I guess that also means we shouldn't bring the things we find over to show everybody.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: That would normally involve touching it, yeah.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: There might be stuff on the ground, so that means we gotta really watch where we walk!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: R-Right. We need to keep an eye out so you guys don't touch anything weird...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
We appreciate the caution...
But I don't think you need to worry that much about us.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Those fragments were born out of all our feelings, no?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
So, I doubt they're that dangerous.
We ultimately managed to wake up, after all.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I agree... I don't think there's any need to worry.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: To be fair, I can't say with absolute certainty...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But that dream had you all going your separate ways to achieve your own goals, yes?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, that's right.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: And because of that dream, I believe the four of you made an important realization all over again.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You felt compelled to make the most of the time you get to spend putting on shows together.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: When you look at it that way, it doesn't seem so scary.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, you're right...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You also said something similar, Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, it was a good reminder of how we need to treasure the time we get to spend together each day.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Also, even if more fragments were to appear in the future, they don't necessarily have to be related to negative feelings.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Next time, they might be fragments born out of fun and joy!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! Fun fragments means you'll all get to see a fun dream, right?♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, if the feelings are powerful enough.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I want my dream to be about eating lots and lots of taiyaki☆

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, Tsukasa, what do you want your dream to be about?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Obviously, about us putting on the best show ever!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh? Shouldn't you be more focused on making that dream come true?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: We did come here to practice for a show.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Right! Let's change gears and get back to working on that!

rows.Speaker: Nene, Emu & Rui
rows.Line:
Yeah.
Yeah!
Yes.
